name: Honda CX500
engine: 497 cc liquid-cooled V-twin, pushrod, shaft drive
intro: Honda's water-cooled V-twin. Very durable once the cam chain, water pump seal and stator are sorted.

A-002.title: Check the cam chain recall marks
A-002.instructions: Look beside the engine number on the lower left crankcase for three punch marks. They show the early cam chain tensioner recall was done. 1978 engines up to CX500E-2034366 were covered.
A-002.reason: The early tensioner could break and lock the engine.

add.title: Listen for cam chain rattle
add.instructions: Start it cold. A rattle that goes away above about 3,000 rpm usually means a worn cam chain. On manual-tensioner bikes, check how much adjustment is left.
add.reason: Not replacing a slapping cam chain is the main cause of CX engine failure.

add.title: Check for water pump seal weep
add.instructions: Look under the water pump cover for coolant weeping. Use silicate-free coolant and distilled water.
add.reason: A failed mechanical seal is an engine-out repair.

H: Cam chain, water pump seal and stator tend to go around 40,000 miles. Owners often do all three in one engine-out job.

recallNote: The 1978 cam chain tensioner recall is long closed. Check for the punch marks instead.

known.title: Cam chain and tensioner
known.what: Needs attention to avoid major engine damage.

known.title: Water pump seal
known.what: Common failure that needs the engine out.
